description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for a GStreamer utility wrapper in the Rialto server component. It includes class declarations for IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper and its factory, as well as related data structures for playback and audio attributes.

classes.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
classes.description: Interface for GStreamer utility functions, including performing audio track codec channel switch.

classes.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper.
